commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+4' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
90+2' Jose Guzman shows the yellow card to Flavien Boyomo (Osasuna) for a heavy challenge.

90+1' 1 - 2 One of the defending players stopped the first attempt, but the ball lands at the feet of Kike Barja (Osasuna) and he unleashes a shot which goes straight into the top left corner, ricocheting in off the post.
90' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
89' The corner is swung into the six-yard box and Asier Osambela (Osasuna) gets his head on the ball, but he is unable to keep it down and it goes miles over the bar.
89' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
89' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) crosses the ball forward but it is intercepted. The referee points to the corner flag and Osasuna will take a corner.
87' Valentin Rosier (Osasuna) tries his luck with and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but it is blocked by one of the defenders.

87' Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) wastes a great chance from the resulting corner. He times his header superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross, but can't aim better than into the middle of the goal, straight into the arms of the goalkeeper.
85' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
85' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Robin Le Normand (Atl. Madrid) is given a yellow card.
85' Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) is punished with the yellow card.
85' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) crosses the ball forward but it is intercepted. Osasuna have been awarded a corner kick.
83' Diego Simeone (Atl. Madrid) gets a yellow card, off the field.
83' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Jose Guzman who sees an offensive foul.
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ademola Lookman departs the field of play to be replaced by Clement Lenglet (Atl. Madrid).
82' Valentin Rosier (Osasuna) has a crack at goal from the edge of the box, but it drifts high over the bar to safety.
79' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) makes a bad challenge and is given a second yellow card which means he's off.
78' The resulting corner from Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
77' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Atl. Madrid.

76' Ambitious effort from Ante Budimir (Osasuna). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar.
75' Kike Barja (Osasuna) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
75' Kike Barja (Osasuna) attempts to send a pass but the effort is blocked. The ball goes out of play. Osasuna are awarded a corner kick.
72' Alessio Lisci prepares a substitution. Moi Gomez is replaced by Asier Osambela (Osasuna).
72' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) will replace Lucas Torro.

71' 0 - 2 A perfect lofted pass from Marcos Llorente finds Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid), who jumps highest and steers a close-range header into the left side of the goal. His effort was both strong and precise, and Aitor Fernandez had no chance of stopping that. 0:2.
70' Koke (Atl. Madrid) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
70' David Hancko (Atl. Madrid) sends a promising through ball, but the defence is alert and cuts out the pass. Atl. Madrid will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
68' Juan Musso steps in and intercepts a long pass from Kike Barja (Osasuna).
67' Osasuna have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

66' A brilliant cross into the box finds Ante Budimir (Osasuna), who directs his header towards the top right corner, but the goalkeeper shows all his agility and makes an astonishing save. The ball is out of play. Osasuna will have a chance to score from a corner.
66' The ball is cleared after Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
64' The attendance is 18647.
62' Kike Barja (Osasuna) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Juan Musso, who pulls off a comfortable save!
60' Alessio Lisci has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Abel Bretones (Osasuna) replacing Javi Galan.
60' Substitution. Ruben Garcia makes his way off the pitch and Raul Garcia (Osasuna) comes on as his replacement.
60' Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header is so wild it sails way past the left post and behind for a goal kick.
60' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
59' Marc Pubill (Atl. Madrid) sees a yellow card from Jose Guzman after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.

54' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) sends a long ball in, but Juan Musso comfortably gathers the ball.
52' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) kept talking out of turn to the referee until Jose Guzman lost patience and pulled out a yellow card.
52' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) latches onto a loose ball inside the box but slams it just over the bar.
52' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) did his best to latch onto a through ball, but it was too strong.

45' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

45' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.
43' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) attempts to release Marc Pubill with a through ball, but his effort is thwarted by one of the defending players.

42' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. Atl. Madrid force a corner. They send men into the box.

41' Marc Pubill (Atl. Madrid) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but Aitor Fernandez has it covered and makes a comfortable save. The ball goes out of play. Atl. Madrid are awarded a corner kick.
38' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
38' A first-time shot by Valentin Rosier (Osasuna) inside the box is unwittingly blocked by one of his own players.
37' Alessio Lisci is forced to make a change. Raul Moro (Osasuna) is unable to continue due to injury, Kike Barja comes on.
36' Raul Moro (Osasuna) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
33' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) sends it out of play.
33' Moi Gomez (Osasuna) attempts to send a pass but the effort is blocked. The ball goes behind for a corner. Osasuna will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
30' Jose Guzman shows a yellow card to Ruben Garcia (Osasuna), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
30' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
29' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
24' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) takes the chance to have an effort at goal from inside the box but blazes it just over the crossbar.
23' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
21' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) gets inside the box and only has the keeper to beat, but lashes his shot way over the bar.
21' The resulting corner from Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
20' Good work from Osasuna as they win a corner.
19' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Ruben Garcia (Osasuna). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
18' Javi Galan (Osasuna) is shown a yellow card by the referee.
18' Rodrigo Mendoza just cannot continue due to injury and has to be substituted. Robin Le Normand (Atl. Madrid) replaces him.

14' Ademola Lookman (Atl. Madrid) is going to take the penalty!

11' A tremendous drive by Rodrigo Mendoza (Atl. Madrid) from inside the box towards the middle of the goal looks like it's in, but Aitor Fernandez makes a brilliant save.
10' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
8' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball goes out of play and Osasuna will have a goal kick.
